responsibility: This definition module declares the C/C++ name-management and dependency-emission interface used by mc’s output stage. It lets clients mark required runtime/library facilities and headers, enter and leave generated scopes, test or mangle source identifiers against target-language keywords and macros, switch on extra C++ reservations, and emit the accumulated include/prototype definitions needed by generated code.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public interface for the keyc stem, declaring the naming-collision, scope-entry, and generated-definition APIs; the same-named .mod file implements the keyword/macro tables, scope stack, usage flags, mangling, and include emission.
